Australian made · Built for Europe's mountains

Fast on. Fast off.
From the Alps to the Arctic.

Quick-release awning hitches and brackets that let you take your awning off in seconds, so the cold, the wind and the snow never get the better of your gear.

The hardware

Built tough.
Made to come off fast.

Quick-release hitches, brackets and accessory plates for awnings, rooftop tents and recovery boards. Australian made.

The Alps

Above the treeline.
Awning off in seconds.

When the wind picks up at altitude, pull the quick-release hitch and keep your awning safe. Put it back when the sky clears.

Nordic winter

Long nights.
Short setup.

Low sun, hard frost and cold hands. A tool-free hitch means less time outside the warm cab and more time on the road north.

Under the northern lights

Cold and clear.
Awning off at dawn.

Frozen water, open sky and the aurora overhead. When the morning comes, take the awning off in seconds and carry on north.

Quick release

Boards on.
Boards off.

Take your recovery boards off the roof in seconds with the HD Hitch, and put them back when you need them.

Iceland and the high north

Wide open skies.
Pack away in seconds.

Frozen plains, big weather and long horizons. Take the awning off before the front rolls in.

Built for the cold side of the mountains

Snow, wind and low sun.
Always ready.

Powder-coated stainless steel and UV-stabilised nylon: no rattle, no rust, season after season.
